title: Hinomori Shiho — Happy Birthday! 2024〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Line: Shiho's birthday
Miyamasuzaka

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
(“Let's meet at the cafe I work at...”
This is probably part of the plan Saki and the others came up with in SEKAI to get me out of the house.)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (And I guess getting Minori to contact me instead of Saki is their way of making this ordeal seem less suspicious...)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (I bet Shizuku and the others are already decorating my room right now too.)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (Who knows what they've turned my room into. Perhaps MEIKO is right. They might just surprise me in the end.)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Even so... They didn't have to start this early. Just what sort of decorations need this much time to put up?
Cafe

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (Alright, now where is Minori?)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Shiho!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Welcome!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: We've been waiting for you, Shiho!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Huh?
What are you all doing here?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Happy birthday, Shii♪

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Whoa!
Sh-Shizuku?!

rows.Speaker: Everyone
rows.Line: Happy birthday!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: W-Wait. What's going on?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Were you surprised, Shiho? You totally were, right?!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: We did it! Our reverse surprise was a success♪

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Reverse surprise? Like I said, what's going on?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: So, the thing is...we talked to everyone after you told us that you overheard about the surprise party.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Sorry for breaking our promise, Shiho!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: But, we both wanted you, Ichika and everyone to enjoy your birthday celebration...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: So that's when Kohane and Minori confided in us. They asked if we had any ideas on how we can turn things around so everyone wins.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yup! We decided to take advantage of the situation and surprise you where you least expected it!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Then we asked Honami and the others whether it was possible to move the birthday party to a different venue.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Since I had a shift on the day we were talking about it, I asked my manager if we had any space.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Turns out that not many people come around this time, so I got the OK♪

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I see. That's why you asked me to come out this early in the morning...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I'm glad that we were able to surprise you.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: But, sorry about all of this, Shiho. Kohane and Minori told us about how you felt about overhearing our plans...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: And also for the incident at the mall. We didn't realize something like that would happen.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: It's okay, that was my fault. I should be the one sorry for making you guys go through so much just for me.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: But I really was genuinely surprised. Thank you all so much.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Shiho...!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: If I had known this was going to happen, I would've brought that thing...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: What thing?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Minori and Kohane didn't tell you? When you all went shopping, I was actually also out shopping for something.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Huh? We were told that you'd be tagging along with Hanasato and Kohane that day...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Hehe. Now it's our turn to surprise all of you.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Shizuku, if you could please!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Of course. Here you are, Shii♪

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Oh! That's the gift I bought with Minori and Kohane.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: We asked Shizuku to sneakily bring it over for us after you left home.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: We also got her to trail right behind you until you got to the cafe.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I'm sorry for going into your room without asking.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: But, here. It's your gift to give.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Okay...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Ichika, Saki, Honami...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Thank you for the surprise. I got you all a gift as a token of my appreciation. Here.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: O-Oh my gosh! There's cute little doggies and bunnies poking their faces out of the donuts!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Oh no! They're so adorable I don't think I can eat them!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Me too! I didn't know there was a place that made cute donuts like this!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Thank you, Shiho! We'll hand over our gifts to you later.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: The three of us went to so many different shops until we found the perfect gift!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I can't wait. Also...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Thank you for all of this, Minori, Kohane. Because of the two of you, I can enjoy the celebration without feeling guilty.

rows.Speaker: Kohane & Minori
rows.Line: Our pleasure!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Thank you all of you as well.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hehe. We only helped a little.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Enough talking and more celebrating! The party has only begun! Let's cut the cake!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
*Gasp*
There's Phenny on the cake!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Since we no longer had to decorate your room, we ended up helping out with the cake and made decorations out of marzipan.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Airi and I made the body and the tail.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Hehe. Minori, Haruka and I were in charge of the hat.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
And we did the face♪
What do you think? The eyes are super cute and round, right?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: We tried to make Phenny resemble you, but maybe we went a little over the top...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: We also made a few beaks to see which one turned out the cutest.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: You guys...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Thank you all so much.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Happy birthday, Shiho! I'm glad the surprise was a success in the end. I was nervous, hoping you wouldn't catch on.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Me too! Especially since you're so sharp, Shiho! But thank you for listening to us and for proposing a great idea, Haruka, Airi!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes. It was thanks to your idea we managed to pull off such a wonderful celebration.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hehe. I wanted Hinomori to enjoy her birthday to the fullest as well, so I'm glad I was able to help Hoshino, Tenma and the others.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Same here. I'm happy that we got to help turn everything around. Happy birthday, Shiho!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Happy birthday, Shiho! I'm sorry I couldn't be there for your party, but I'll be sure to wish you a happy birthday again once the new school term starts!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Haha. It'll be like “Happy Birthday Part 2♪”
In that case, I might just do the same!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: It sounds like there are a lot of surprises in store for her... But, if you're going ahead with it, then I'd like to help. Especially since she's helped me in a lot of ways too.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: And it's at times like this, we should take extra care to express our gratitude. So, from the bottom of our hearts, happy birthday, Shiho.

rows.Speaker: Ichika, Saki & Tsukasa
rows.Line: Happy birthday!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: It was surprise after surprise at the birthday party, but overall I had a lot of fun.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I was genuinely caught off-guard, and to think that everyone would do so much to celebrate my birthday...makes me so happy.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: All of this made me realize just how many people are there for me.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: And I want to work hard and be there for them too.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Thank you all so much for celebrating my birthday with me.
